idea.title: APIMock — Mock REST API server with instant JSON schema validation

plan.tagline: Instant local REST API mocking with JSON schema validation
plan.problem: Developers waste hours writing fake API servers or waiting for backend teams to build endpoints for frontend testing.
plan.solution: Run a local mock REST API server in seconds with predefined JSON schemas and instant validation—no internet, no dependencies, no Flask.
plan.target_market: Solo developers, indie hackers, and small businesses building web/mobile apps that need to test API integrations before real backend exists.
mvp_features: Instant local API server with --start command
JSON schema validation on every request

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: sqlite schema for endpoints + add/list commands

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: endpoint activity logs + validation error alerts

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: --demo mode with 3 endpoints + --help + edge case fixes

plan.demo_script: Run 'apimock --demo' to start a mock server on port 8000 with 3 endpoints (/users, /products, /orders). Each returns valid JSON matching its schema. Test with curl or Postman—no internet needed.
plan.phuket_angle: Phuket hotels/restaurants can use it to mock booking/order APIs for their mobile apps without waiting for backend development during peak season.
